Definition: The proximate obstacle that best explains the thread's central technical or community problem.
Directly evidenced mechanisms or consequences; not inferred merely because they are generally related.
Contextual mention or thin product claim.
Relevant discussion with limited technical detail or outcome evidence.
Explicit multi-turn technical discussion with useful implementation detail.
Detailed incident, post-mortem, measured report, or technically rich discussion with traceable reasoning.
Original poster or maintainers indicate the issue was fixed or a working solution was implemented.
A workaround, diagnosis, or design exists; outcome remains incomplete or locally validated.
No publicly confirmed solution in the reviewed material.
Outcome or metric is reported by the developer/vendor and has not been independently verified here.
Substantive work explicitly moved to DM, Slack, private support, meetings, or another restricted channel.
Short, technically material, non-identifying, context-preserving, linked, and within source quotation limits.
